LESSON: ELECTRICAL ENERGY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 4.1: Electrical Energy

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Electrical Energy. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Electrical Energy
2. Practise Electrical Energy at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Electrical Energy

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Electrical Energy
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Electrical Energy. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Electrical Energy at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Electrical Energy at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Electrical Energy
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Electrical Energy. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Electrical Energy using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Electrical Energy in the examples.
2. Explain Electrical Energy to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Electrical Energy.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Electrical Energy using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Electrical Energy important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Electrical Energy
2. Practise Electrical Energy at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Electrical Energy

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
